correctness.rationale: The normalized finite Heisenberg representations are fully enumerated via dimension-square count. A precisely counted at-most-two-run event and the exact XYX/YXY conditional central laws prove both TV bounds. Limiting profiles follow with controlled O(t/sqrt(Q)) errors near log q. The supplied exact integer-convolution checker rederived chi-square and bounded TV for q=2,3,4,5,7 and m=1,2,3, with composite field order 4 correctly modeled.

value.rationale: The full exact spectrum and all-time chi-square identity identify the harmonic obstruction in a natural noncommutative smoothing walk, while a sharp \(t/2^{t-1}\) total-variation law proves that the same walk mixes on a fundamentally smaller scale in that metric. This structural metric-separation phenomenon persists over every prime-power field and nontrivial dimension, with explicit reproducible critical profiles; it is not a trivial parameter substitution or isolated small-case enumeration.
